items.title: Mahjong Sweet Connection
items.description: Indulge in "Mahjong Sweet Connection," where matching sweet icons becomes a strategic adventure. Navigate puzzles with a unique linking system, requiring precision as paths twist through limited angles. With escalating complexity, vibrant graphics, and a soothing atmosphere, it's the perfect mix of leisure and challenge.

items.title: Mahjong Sweet Easter
items.description: Experience the festive joy of matching vibrant Easter-themed tiles in Mahjong Sweet Easter. Battle the clock and tackle the unique "gravity" twist, where cleared layers shift the board dynamics. Perfect your strategy and quick reflexes to clear the board and immerse yourself in this delightful, challenging adventure.

items.title: Mahjong Tower
items.description: Step into the ancient world of Mahjong Tower, where engaging strategy meets intricate puzzle design. Unravel the secrets of iconic structures formed from mahjong tiles. Employ your wits to dismantle these clever constructions by pairing identical tiles, ensuring the board is cleared in this captivating journey through time.

items.title: Feed the Parrot
items.description: Embark on a relaxing adventure with a delightful parrot as you solve vibrant fruit-tiled puzzles. Match identical fruits to clear levels in a world of charming pixel art. Enjoy leisurely-paced, engaging challenges that enhance your logical thinking, perfect for unwinding and friendly competition. Feed the parrot and delight in the fun!

items.title: Mahjong Deluxe
items.description: Dive into Mahjong Deluxe, where each game offers a fresh, unique puzzle experience. With limitless board layouts and varying difficulty levels, it challenges your strategy and speed. Enjoy seamless tile-matching and strive to beat your personal best in this captivating modern twist on a classic game.

items.title: Mahjong at Home - Scandinavian Edition
items.description: Immerse yourself in the tranquil beauty of snow-covered Nordic landscapes with Mahjong at Home - Scandinavian Edition. Enjoy a serene yet challenging puzzle adventure that enhances your strategic thinking and observation skills, all at your own leisurely pace in a world where meticulous planning is key.

items.title: Mahjong Garden
items.description: Discover Mahjong Garden, where strategic thinking takes center stage. Connect matching tiles to clear your path while soaking in the serene, oriental atmosphere. With no time pressure and customizable themes, enjoy a relaxed, yet mentally stimulating challenge. Elevate your mind as you unlock novel visual delights.

items.title: Mahjong for Free
items.description: Immerse yourself in the timeless puzzle of Mahjong for Free, where strategic tile matching meets a serene, untimed experience. Delight in customizable visuals as you connect identical tiles to clear the board, all while exploring enchanting oriental themes and enhancing your logic and visualization skills.

items.title: Mahjong Riddles Egypt
items.description: Embark on an Egyptian adventure, solving intriguing Mahjong puzzles to unearth hidden treasures. Test your speed and observation by matching tiles, navigating through ancient paths filled with challenging layouts. Collect artifacts as you progress, diving deeper into a mythical, captivating version of Egypt with each puzzle you conquer.

items.title: Mahjong Pair Up
items.description: Dive into Mahjong Pair Up, where your objective is to clear the board by pairing identical tiles. Navigate thrilling puzzles with strategic tile moves and plan ahead to conquer each challenge. With accessible gameplay, this delightful adventure sharpens your observation skills and promises endless fun for all puzzle enthusiasts.

items.title: Mahjong Sakura Petals
items.description: Immerse yourself in Mahjong Sakura Petals, where traditional mahjong meets the allure of Japanese culture. Solve captivating puzzles beneath a blossoming Sakura and majestic Mount Fuji. Navigate tantalizing challenges that require keen strategy and careful planning, all set in a visually stunning atmosphere that's both serene and mentally stimulating.

items.title: Mahjong Pet Quest
items.description: Embark on a delightful journey with Mahjong Pet Quest, where charming animal-themed tiles create a playful twist on traditional Mahjong. Engage in vibrant, logic-testing puzzles that meld relaxation with challenge. Enjoy soothing music and a whimsical atmosphere as you clear levels and experience endless tile-matching fun.

items.title: Cafe 3 in a Row
items.description: Tile your way through a culinary-themed puzzle adventure, where organizing vibrant cafe-inspired tiles grants a satisfying sense of order. Relax and strategize as you match three-of-a-kind to clear the screen, using power-ups when needed, in this delightfully charming and unhurried challenge.

items.title: Mahjong Slide & Merge
items.description: Immerse yourself in Mahjong Slide & Merge, a thrilling twist on classic solitaire. Skillfully slide tiles, match pairs, and strategically clear the board for a satisfying, brain-teasing experience. Enjoy the perfect blend of relaxation and challenge in this addictive puzzle adventure.

items.title: Mahjong Tiles Matching
items.description: Dive into Mahjong Tiles Matching, where traditional mahjong meets Match-3 puzzle fun. Strategically swap to align three identical tiles, clearing the board as you tackle complex puzzles. With intuitive controls and engaging challenges, enjoy endless entertainment that sharpens your mind and tests your tactical prowess.

items.title: Mahjong Farm
items.description: Experience the serene charm of Mahjong Farm, where strategic tile matching meets farmyard fun. Race against time in each level as you uncover and pair topmost tiles amidst a tranquil rural backdrop, accompanied by calming melodies. Sharpen your skills and immerse yourself in this delightful puzzle adventure.

items.title: Magic Mahjong
items.description: Immerse yourself in Magic Mahjong, merging traditional gameplay with enchanting runes. Strategically match open runes from intricate layouts, tackling escalating challenges. Unleash your puzzling prowess to earn points in this captivating journey of wit and wizardry.

items.title: Just Mahjong
items.description: Experience serene simplicity in "Just Mahjong." Focus solely on classic mahjong solitaire across hundreds of thoughtfully crafted layouts, ensuring countless hours of tranquil, uninterrupted gameplay.

items.title: Mahjong Solitaire - Butterfly Connect
items.description: Unleash your concentration in Mahjong Solitaire - Butterfly Connect, where vibrant butterflies await your discovery. Connect identical pairs to set them free, clear levels, and marvel at rare species. Enjoy endless fun solving puzzles and earning stars in this enchanting adventure. Hints ensure you’re never stuck!
